description.value:
Demonic Illusion: Hell Viewing Technique. The target is made to see their worst fear — usually a vivid, personal image (dead loved one, dishonor, drowning).

The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is frightened 1.

Failure The target is frightened 2 and takes 4d6 mental damage as their nervous system reacts to the impossible image.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is also fleeing for 1 round.

Heightened (+2) Mental damage increases by 2d6.

system.requirements: you can meet the target's gaze
